'''Refinery 435''' was a [[colat]] metal [[Refinery/Legends|refinery]] owned and operated by [[Lant Mining Corporation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demar]]. It was targeted by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] forces during [[Operation: Insignificant]].
